title: Kamishiro Rui — How Far I Have To Go〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: How Far I Have To Go（4★）

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Alright, where's Luka?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was hoping to let her know that I succeeded on my assignment.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, she's sleeping on that bench.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(While clinging to that cloud cushion again.
She must've taken quite a liking to it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'd rather not wake her, so I'll just wait until...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...? Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good morning. Did you sleep well?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Like a baby, thanks to this fluffy cushion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, Rui, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I came over to tell you that I've finished presenting my show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You did give me a valuable piece of advice while I was struggling with it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did everything go well?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping to give you good news, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I think the best way to put it is that my show failed to meet certain criteria.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The teachers gave me mixed reviews. They lauded some aspects of it, but its uneven quality left opinions divided.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One of the criteria was whether the show would be suitable to be shown at ArcLand, and they decided that it was not.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was a painful reminder of just how much I have left to learn.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, Rui, you seem rather relieved.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's because I gave it absolutely everything I had.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have points to reflect and improve upon, but I don't regret a thing. I see this as having overcome a significant challenge as a director.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The results aside, I'm quite satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Y-Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you sound sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, my apologies...
I haven't been able to get much sleep lately.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that I'm able to relax, the fatigue that I've accrued seems to be hitting me all at once.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It goes to show how hard you've been pushing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know. Why don't you rest here for a while? You can even use this cushion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then, I think I'll rest my eyes for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, this cushion feels much nicer than I realized. And it's just the right softness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can see why you like it so much, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right?
Isn't it wonderfully soft and comfy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it really is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let me know anytime if you'd like to use it, okay? I'll bring it over...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, he fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
This is like the opposite of normal.
Usually I'm asleep, and Rui watches over me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Nighty night. Sleep tight.
